questions.question: The ratio of selling price to the cost price is 8 ∶ 11. What is the loss percentage?
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of the selling price to the cost price is 8 ∶ 11 

Formula used:

Profit % = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100%

Where, SP = Selling price, CP = Cost price

Calculation:

Let the cost price (C.P.) and selling price (S.P.) of the article be 11x and 8x respectively.

According to the question,

loss % = [(11x - 8x)/11x] × 100%

loss % = (3x/11x) × 100 = 27.27%

∴ The Loss percent is 27.27%.

questions.question: P, Q and R alone can do a piece of work in 5, 6 and 4 days respectively. All three of them began the work together but Q left 1 days before completion of the work. In how many days was the work completed?
questions.solution:
Given: 

P, Q and R alone can do a piece of work in 5, 6 and 4 days respectively

Concept used:

Total work = Work done per day × Total time taken

Calculation:

Total work = LCM of 5, 6 and 4 = 60

Efficiency of P = 60/5 = 12

Efficiency of Q = 60/6 = 10

Efficiency of R = 60/4 = 15

Let the work be completed in x days.

According to the question,

⇒ 12 × x + 10 × (x - 1) + 15 × x = 60 

⇒ 37x = 70

x = 70/37

∴ The answer is 70/37 days.

questions.question: Two successive discounts of 10 percent and 15 percent are given by Rajat on a shirt. If the marked price of the shirt is Rs. 800, then what is the value of discount?
questions.solution:
Given:

Marked price of shirt = Rs. 800

**Formula used**

Selling price = (100 - D)% of MP

Discount = MP - SP

Calculation:

Selling price of shirt after two discounts = (100 - 10)% of (100 - 15)% of 800

= 0.9 × 0.85 × 800 = Rs. 612

Total discount = Marked price - Selling price = 800 - 612 = Rs. 188

∴ The value of the discount is Rs.188

questions.question: Two trains are moving in the same direction at the speed of 44 km/hr and 70 km/hr. The time taken by faster train to cross a man sitting in the slower train is 72 seconds. What will be the length of the faster train?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Two trains are moving in the same direction at the speed of 44 km/hr and 70 km/hr

**Formula used**

Time = Distance/(Difference of speed)

**Calculation**

Let the speed of the fast train is Sf , and the speed of the slow train is Sₛ.

⇒ (Length of the fast train)/Time = Sf – Sₛ 

⇒ (Length of fast train)/72 = 5/18 × (70 - 44) 

⇒ Length of fast train = 5/18 × 26 × 72 

∴ Length of fast train = 520

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 3000 becomes Rs. 4320 in 2 years at a certain rate of compound interest (compounding annually). How much this sum will become after 4 years?
questions.solution:
Given:

Amount = Rs. 4320

Principal = Rs. 3000

Time = 2 years

Concept:

A = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Calculation:

Let, rate = r.

According to the question,

⇒ 4320 = 3000 × (1 + r/100)²

⇒ (4320/3000) = (1 + r/100)²

⇒ (144/100) = (1 + r/100)²

⇒ 1 + r/100 = 12/10

⇒ r = 2/10 × 100 = 20%

After 2 more years, 4320 will become:

⇒ A = 4320 × (1 + 20/100)2

⇒ A = 4320 × (6/5)²

⇒ A = 6220.8

∴ In 4 years Rs. 3000 will amount to Rs. 6220.8 at 20% p.a. compound interest.

questions.question: The length of a cuboid is 4 cm. If the breadth of the cuboid is four times of its length and height of the cuboid is twice of its length, then what is the lateral surface area of the cuboid?
questions.solution:
Given Data:

length = 4 cm.

breadth= 4 times of Length.

Height = twice of length 

Formula:

lateral surface area of the cuboid = 2(l + b)h

Solution:

breadth = 4 × 4 = 16

Height = 2 × 4 = 8.

lateral surface area of the cuboid = 2(l + b)h

⇒ 2(4 + 16) × 8 = 320 cm2

Hence, the **lateral surface area** of the cuboid is 320 cm².

questions.question: The average weight of a group of 20 persons is 40 kg. The average weight of another group of 40 persons is K kg. If the average weight of all the 60 persons is 60 kg, then what is the value of K?
questions.solution:
Given: 

The average weight of 20 persons = 40 kg

The average weight of another group of 40 persons = K kg.

The average weight of 60 persons = 60 kg

Formula:

Average = (Sum of observations) / (Number of observations)

Solution:

⇒ 20 × 40 + 40 × k = 60 × 60

⇒ 800 + 40 × k = 3600

⇒ 40 × k = 2800

k = 70

The answer is 70 kg.

questions.question: What is the HCF of 2.7 and 20.25?
questions.solution:
Given:

Decimal numbers 2.7 and 20.25

Formula Used:

HCF of a fraction = HCF(numerator)/LCM(denominator)

Calculation:

Converting each of the following decimals into like decimals we get;

270 and 2025 (multiplying by 100 and after the result will divide by the same)

Now, expressing each of the numbers without the decimals as the product of primes we get

270 = 2 × 3³ × 5 

2025 = 3⁴ × 5² 

HCF = 33 × 5 = 135

HCF(2.7 and 20.25) = 1.35

**The answer is 1.35 **

questions.question: Vyom purchased 40 dozen peas at the rate Rs. 56 per dozen He sold 15 dozen at 20 percent profit and the remaining 25 dozen at 10 percent profit. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Given:

Vyom purchased 40 dozen pens at the rate Rs 56 per dozen.

He sold 15 dozen at the profit = 20%

The remaining 25 dozen at the profit = 10%

Formula:

SP = CP × (100 + Profit%)/100

Profit = SP – CP

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

Calculation:

Total cost price of 40 dozen pens = 40 × 56 = Rs. 2240

The total selling price of 30 dozen pens :

⇒ 15 × 56 × [120/100] + 25 × 56 × [110/100]

⇒ 1008 + 1540

⇒ 2548

Profit = 2548 – 2240

∴ Profit = 308

Profit % = (308/2240) × 100

∴ Profit % = 13.75%

**The answer is 13.75%**

questions.question: A child has 50 paisa coins and 1 rupee coins. The ratio of the number of 50 paise and 1 rupee coins is 4 ∶ 3. If he has an amount of Rs. 10, then how many 50 paisa coins does he have?
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of the number of 50 paise and 1 rupee coins is 4 ∶ 3

The total amount = Rs.10

Calculation:

Let 50 paise and 1 rupee coins be 4x and 3x.

According to the questions,

⇒ 0.50 × (4x) + 1 × 3x = 10

⇒ 2x + 3x = 10

⇒ x = 2

⇒ 0.50 paise coin = 4x → 4 × 2 = 8

∴ The number of 50 paise coins is 8.

questions.question: If 26a + 26b = 234, then what is the average of a and b?
questions.solution:
**Given**

26a + 26b = 234

**Formula used**

Average = Sum of all value/No. of values

**Calculation**

⇒ 26(a + b) = 234

⇒ (a + b) = 9

⇒ (a + b)/2 = 9/2

⇒ (a + b)/2 = 4.5

**The answer is 4.5**
